IGUI_GS_AddonsIntro: Read the addon magazine, craft the module, then install it here. Each module binds to this terminal.
IGUI_GS_AddonsNeedTerminal: Open the terminal from a placed GS unit to manage addons.
IGUI_GS_AddonsEmpty: No addons registered. Enable optional addon mods from the Workshop.
IGUI_GS_AddonStatusModOff: Enable the addon mod in your mod list.
IGUI_GS_AddonNeedReader: You need the GS Floppy Drive in your main inventory to install this addon.
IGUI_GS_AddonNeedDisk: You need this addon's own installation disk in your inventory to install it.
IGUI_GS_AddonReqModule: Peripheral built and in your inventory
IGUI_GS_AddonReqUninstallDisk: Uninstall disk in your inventory (not consumed)
IGUI_GS_AddonReqReader: SiK Reader installed on this network or in your inventory
IGUI_GS_AddonStatusReady: Ready to install (read the magazine, craft the module, keep it in inventory).
IGUI_GS_AddonStatusNeedMagazine: Read the addon magazine to unlock recipes and installation.
IGUI_GS_AddonBayHint: M = manual read · + = module installed · border shows readiness.
IGUI_GS_AddonMagMissing: Manual: read the addon magazine to unlock the module recipe.
IGUI_GS_AddonModuleMissing: Module: craft the install module or keep it in your inventory.
IGUI_GS_AddonTabletDesc: Tablet add-on: magazine required (Electricity 5). Install module on this terminal.
IGUI_GS_AddonReaderDesc: GS Floppy Drive: magazine required (Electricity 6). Install it on this terminal so you no longer need to carry it to install other modules here.
IGUI_GS_AddonCraftDesc: Craft add-on: magazine required (Electricity 5). Install module on this terminal.
IGUI_GS_AddonBuilderDesc: Builder add-on: magazine required (Electricity 5). Craft and install module from Add-ons tab.
IGUI_GS_AddonCookDesc: Cook add-on: magazine required (Electricity 5). Craft and install module from Add-ons tab.
IGUI_GS_PermCharacterHintDropdown: Add access only from the dropdowns below.
IGUI_GS_BlockedTabletAddon: Craft and install the Tablet Link Module on a GS terminal, and enable the tablet addon mod.
IGUI_GS_CraftModRecipesHint: Terminal and wireless tablet. Materials are taken from your inventory.
IGUI_GS_CraftRemoteHint: Open the game crafting UI; network containers are added while you have terminal access.
IGUI_GS_BuildRemoteHint: Open the game building UI; network containers are added while you have terminal access.
IGUI_GS_CraftSessionActive: Session active: {1} network containers available for crafting.
IGUI_GS_StatsFuelTooltipOn:
Base consumption: {1}
Per-container consumption: {2} x {3} containers
Total consumption: {4} (generator fuel unit) per game hour.
Only applies while the network is running off a nearby active generator, never off the normal grid.
IGUI_GS_StatsFuelTooltipOff: Fuel consumption is turned off (sandbox option 'Consume generator fuel'). The network doesn't consume anything, it just requires power to be present.
IGUI_GS_WeightWarn: Storage almost full ({1})! Add crates, rescan zones, or create a new zone.
IGUI_GS_WeightCritical: Storage critical ({1})! Expand soon: place more boxes and rescan.
IGUI_GS_WeightFull: Network storage full. Add capacity before depositing more items.
IGUI_GS_ZonesManageHint: Edit name and press Save. Rescan updates containers in that zone only. Delete removes the zone.
IGUI_GS_ZoneDeleteConfirm: Delete zone "{1}"? Containers inside stay in the network, they just stop being grouped under this zone.
IGUI_GS_NoItems: No items in network. Create a zone and rescan.
IGUI_GS_Guide1: 1. Setup: create a zone (room or MP safehouse) and rescan.
IGUI_GS_Guide2: 2. Containers: rename each box and pick one category for auto-sort.
IGUI_GS_Guide3: 3. Items: search, withdraw, or drag inventory -> terminal / right-click -> Transfer.
IGUI_GS_Guide4: 4. Network: power status and scan summary.
IGUI_GS_Guide5: Access: hover Inventory on the left bar -> GS icon -> click.
IGUI_GS_Welcome: Hover Inventory on the left bar and click the GS icon. Configure zones here, then manage containers and items.
IGUI_GS_ZonePickStart: Click first corner of the storage area. Right-click or ESC to cancel.
IGUI_GS_ZonePickSecond: Click the opposite corner to finish the zone.
IGUI_GS_ZonePickSameFloor: Both corners must be on the same floor.
IGUI_GS_ZonePickFailed: Could not send zone to server.
IGUI_GS_BlockedCraftHint: Craft the GS terminal from the vanilla crafting menu when you have the requirements.
IGUI_GS_FilterTagHint: Vanilla item tag (case-sensitive), e.g. Cookable, Water, Book.
IGUI_GS_PCAcquireIntro: Build a plain desktop computer from spare parts, right into your inventory - no crafting menu involved.
IGUI_GS_PCAcquireSuccess: Desktop computer added to your inventory.
IGUI_GS_PCAcquireFailBook: You need to read the manual first.
IGUI_GS_AcquireFailTools: You need a soldering iron and a screwdriver for this.
IGUI_GS_AcquireFailSkill: Your Electricity skill isn't high enough for this yet.
IGUI_GS_ReaderAcquireIntro: Assemble a GS Floppy Drive from its 3 parts, right into your inventory - no crafting menu involved.
IGUI_GS_ReaderAcquireSuccess: GS Floppy Drive added to your inventory.
IGUI_GS_ReaderAcquireFailBook: You need to read the manual first.
IGUI_GS_ProgramDiskFailBook: You need to read the programming magazine first.
IGUI_GS_ProgramDiskFailTerminal: You need to be near a terminal to program a disk.
IGUI_GS_ProgrammingHint: Write disks for this network without carrying the floppy drive - requires the Reader peripheral installed here.
IGUI_GS_ProgrammingNeedsBook: You haven't learned this recipe yet.
IGUI_GS_ProgrammingNeedsBlankDisk: You need a blank disk nearby.
IGUI_GS_NodeNotesHint: This container's label, to remember where it is or what it's for. If you have Customizable Containers installed, it stays in sync with its label.

IGUI_GS_ScanOutOfRange: Too far from a terminal (not added): {1}

IGUI_GS_NoZones: No containers. Create a zone in Setup and press Rescan.
IGUI_GS_NodesHelp: Rename containers and pick one category. «Any» = accept all items.
IGUI_GS_NodesHelpShort: Click + on a zone to expand/collapse. Right-click zone header to highlight. Name and category: right-click the container in the world.
IGUI_GS_CategoryPickSpecific: Pick a more specific option in the second dropdown.
IGUI_GS_MemberEditorLeaveConfirm: Leave this network? If you're the owner, ownership passes automatically to another admin or member, same as on death.
IGUI_GS_PermSuccessionHint: If you die, ownership passes automatically to the first available admin or member.
IGUI_GS_PermNoBackupWarn: No other members: if you die, this network will be left without an owner.
IGUI_GS_OnlyOwnerRemoveAdminsMsg: Only the owner can remove admins
IGUI_GS_OnlyOwnerChangeRolesMsg: Only the owner can change roles
IGUI_GS_OnlyOwnerRenameNetworkMsg: Only the owner can rename the network

IGUI_GS_DropHint: Drag items here or right-click inventory -> Transfer to Global Storage
IGUI_GS_WithdrawDragHint: Drag a row to an inventory panel to withdraw there

IGUI_GS_BlockedApproachTablet: You have the tablet: stay within wireless range of a placed terminal.
IGUI_GS_BlockedApproachCraft: No terminal in range yet. Craft one below or move closer to your placed unit.

IGUI_GS_LinkIntro: Craft a terminal (New terminal tab) or use one in inventory. Pick a network and place it: no need to recover a destroyed terminal.
IGUI_GS_LinkHelp: Multiple terminals per network are allowed (limit and distance from storage apply). To move an existing placed terminal, use «Prepare relocation» below.
IGUI_GS_PlacementChoiceIntro: New network or link to one you already belong to? The server validates permissions and distance from storage.
IGUI_GS_PlacementPrepared: Ready. Place the terminal in the world.
IGUI_GS_PlaceNeedTerminalItem: You need a GS Terminal in inventory (craft it in the other tab).
IGUI_GS_TerminalTooFar: Too far from storage or other terminals on this network.

IGUI_GS_InstallReaderIntro: New network or link to one you already belong to? Linking requires being within {1} tiles of another terminal on that network. The computer itself never changes, only the position gets registered.
IGUI_GS_InstallReaderNoNetworks: You don't belong to any network yet. Type a name above and hit Create instead.
IGUI_GS_InstallReaderNotComputer: No installable computer at that spot anymore.
IGUI_GS_InstallReaderAlreadyInstalled:
That computer already has a SiK Terminal installed.
Open it with our access button (inventory menu, on the left) or by pressing {1} (Options > Keyboard shortcuts).
To reassign it, uninstall it first from the Network tab's terminal table.
IGUI_GS_InstallReaderNeedReaderShort: Missing: GS Floppy Drive in main inventory

IGUI_GS_BlockedNoNetworksYet: You don't belong to any storage network yet.
IGUI_GS_InstallReaderMissingItems: You need the GS Floppy Drive and the OS disk in your inventory.
IGUI_GS_UninstallConfirm: Uninstall this terminal? The computer stays where it is, only this network stops recognizing that position. If this is the last terminal you won't be able to reach the network's storage until you install another one.
IGUI_GS_RecoveryIntro: Select your network and click «Prepare relocation». Then pick up the GS terminal and place it again to re-link that network. Without preparing, a new terminal creates a separate network.
IGUI_GS_RecoveryPickNetwork: Pick a network from the list.
IGUI_GS_RecoveryNoAnchor: No registered anchor (suspended or missing terminal).
IGUI_GS_RecoveryStatusDisplaced: Status: terminal displaced or no active anchor.
IGUI_GS_RecoveryAwaitingPlace: Relocation prepared: pick up the terminal and place it.
IGUI_GS_RecoveryPrepareSuccess: Done. Pick up the GS terminal and place it where you want to use it.
IGUI_GS_RecoveryHelp: 1) Prepare relocation · 2) Pick up terminal (right-click / move) · 3) Place again. Placing a new terminal without preparing creates a separate network.
IGUI_GS_BuildPlaceHint: Click to place the terminal. ESC cancels.
IGUI_GS_BuildAlreadyPending: You already have a terminal waiting to be placed
IGUI_GS_BuildUseConstruct: Use Build in the GS window (not craft)
IGUI_GS_InstallTerminalIntro: Convert this vanilla desktop into a GS network terminal. You need the GS magazine, materials, and Electricity skill. After installation you can place it on the map.
IGUI_GS_CraftFloppyFail: You need the GS Network OS Disk in your inventory
IGUI_GS_CraftDesktopFail: You need a vanilla desktop computer in your inventory

IGUI_GS_PermCharacterHint: Access is by character name (forename + surname), not Steam account.
IGUI_GS_PermNoFaction: You are not in a faction.
IGUI_GS_NetworkNameHint: Each placed terminal creates a network. The visible name can change; the ID cannot.
IGUI_GS_NetworkSingleHint: Each terminal creates a unique network. A player or faction may operate several networks.

IGUI_GS_NoPermAccess: No extra users or factions. The owner always has access.
